title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: To avoid repeating a year, bookish first-year Ume Mizunoe joins the student council of a private academy and finds a crew of eccentrics: a president who gets flustered by anything sexual, an accident-prone officer, a sadistic ex-delinquent treasurer and a feminine-looking, perverted middle-school boy. It is a 4-panel gag comedy with a slow crush between Ume and the president (Wikipedia; Seven Seas blurb via MangaUpdates; AnimeOshi).
life_message: A group of flawed oddballs can still become a place where you belong.

content.note: Treasurer Arisu beats up Tan as slapstick (Wikipedia; AniList Slapstick 80).

Civic vs kin.evidence: The council, not family, is the core group.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Council ranks and year levels, worn lightly.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: No religion or custom at issue.

folkways.japan: The student council and senpai-kohai year ranks are standard Japanese school settings, and a 4-koma gag format is a common Japanese comedy form.

delivery.evidence: AnimeOshi: 'pure comedy' with no other storylines; no message is pressed (to verify for the manga).
delivery.note: A gag comedy with little message beyond friendship, carried by situations rather than statements.

winners_losers: No real winners or losers; the misfits stick together. Sympathy goes to the oddballs.
